text:
Ana (product): heads-up — competitor launched a cheaper embedding+search combo. we're getting 3 inbound deals asking for similar unit economics. need a quick tilt vs hedge plan this sprint. :eyes:
Mike (PM): can you paste the competitive notes + perf delta? also need launch criteria (ok to be a lite feature?)
Ana (product): perf delta ~= 20% slower on 2k token reranks, cost ~40% lower. notes: https://docs.internal/comp/cheaper-embed (summary attached). suggestion: two paths — 1) feature tilt: build price-tiered offering with quantized model + docs; 2) hedge: compatibility adapter + routing to cheaper partner model.
Jasper (eng): engineering reality — full quantize+deploy path is ~3 sprints to be safe (QA + eval). compatibility adapter (proxy + format shim) is ~2w, low risk.
Lina (sales): we have 2 pilots asking for sub-50% cost. if we can show a short-term adapter we keep the deals. buyers care about SLA and data controls though.
Frank (solutions): compatibility adapter approach: expose a per-tenant routing flag, emulate api surface, transform params. quick snippet: ```routing_policy: - name: cheap_fallback percent: 5 condition: tenant in pilot```
Eva (data): metric to watch: per-tenant token spend, 7d retention, error rate increase. current baseline: avg token cost $0.007/token. pilot target $0.0035/token.
Ruth (design): UX things: surface "cost tier" in the console, warn about possible quality delta, allow switch per-route. mockup is tiny.
deploy-bot: canary rollout job queued for `tilt-compat-adapter` at 05:30 UTC :rocket:
Mike (PM): proposal: short term (next 2 weeks) deliver compatibility adapter for pilots + console toggle + telemetry. medium term (2-3 sprints) evaluate quantized tier as real product if metrics hold. launch criteria for adapter: <1.5x error rate, pilot cost target hit for 2 customers, no SLA escalations.
Jasper (eng): agree. I'll spike adapter today, estimate 3 engineers for 2w to ship canary.
Ana (product): action items: Jasper to own spike + PRD; Frank to spec adapter transforms; Eva to set dashboards; Lina to consolidate pilot list + comms; Ruth to put toggle UI in low-fi. Mike will write roll decision doc.
Lina (sales): I'll ping acme & betaco to confirm pilot acceptance window this week.
Mike (PM): OK assigning: Jasper -> PRD (due Tue), Frank -> api shim spec (due Wed), Eva -> dashboard (Mon), Ruth -> console toggle mock (Mon), Lina -> pilot signoffs (EOW). if any blockers ping #eng-oncall.
Ana (product): if metrics are good after 2 weeks we greenlight productization. if negative, we'll hedge with partner routing and file a quantization spike. thanks all. :thumbsup:
